rows.text: under an NCLT Mumbai order of 2 September, sends **notices to shareholders and creditors on the composite amalgamation of TMF Holdings and TMF Business Services** into itself; the meetings are dispensed with but representations are invited.

rows.quant: EUR 14.1 per share, cash; Exor tenders ~27.06%
rows.text: launches its **recommended all-cash voluntary tender offer for all Iveco Group common shares at EUR 14.1 cum dividend**, the acceptance period running 7 September to 26 October
